      Prototype 0.78 · Locker fix

      Tiny TitansFood Fight

      You're frog-sized, and the whole kitchen is the arena. Food is the only weapon. Fight 11 bots or your friends online, alone or in teams of 2, 3 or 4, until the Soap Tide closes in; smash the other teams' pots in Cooking Pot Wars; outsplat the other team in Squads; or fight over two Legendary utensils in King of the Utensil.

      Prototype of the Tiny Titans design document: 13 foods with ultimate alts, 18 utensils and 6 Legendary ones, three maps, 12 Titans.

      Mouse

      Right-click Q
      Your food's ultimate alt: Tomato Dash, Ice Storm, Melon Smash, Mega Jump, Juice Ball, Spike Line, Jump Pad, Teleport, Berry Spiral, Flamethrower (and eat, shield, sugar rush)
      Space
      Jump · press again in the air to double jump

      9
      Food only: put your utensils away and throw just the food (R comes round to it too; on a phone, the open hand on the utensil plate)

      V
      Switch first / third person
      G

      T
      Cooking Pot Wars: climb into (or out of) your pot's turret, then aim and throw from it
      Enter

      Esc P
      Pause
      Left thumb
      Drag anywhere on the left to move (push far to sprint)
      Right thumb
      Drag on the right to aim
      Aim stick
      Hold it to charge (or to fire blueberries non-stop) and drag to aim; let go to throw
      Jump · Dash
      Tap Jump again in the air to double jump; Dash for a quick burst
      Plates
      Turn the food plate (bottom left) or the utensil plate (bottom right) either way like a dial, or tap it to step to the next one; a plate has one place for each thing you carry
      Sniff
      Points at Titans making noise; quiet ones stay hidden

      On the menu today

        Support utensils

        Utensils arrive in delivery boxes that parachute into the kitchen (follow the coloured light beams). Walk into a box to open it and carry the utensil, or splat it open with food from range. You carry up to three and switch between them like food; with all three full, a new one swaps out the one in your hand, and knocked-out Titans drop all of theirs. A utensil boosts every food you throw, even the banana peel trap for some, but the food is still the shot, and every boost has a cost.

          Hazards: the three burners cycle on (don't stand on them), the sink and spilled water make you Wet (cleanses sticky and fire, but freezes last longer), honey pools refill your Glaze shield, and the red spatula pads on the floor fling you up onto the counters and the table. Smash the giant tomato for extra ammo. The floor is scattered with giant fallen food and knocked-over chairs to hide behind and climb, a pickle jar you can walk into, and a cracked egg whose white is slippery.

          Teams and modes

          Every mode plays Solo (every Titan for themselves) or in Duos, Trios or Squads: 6 teams of 2, 4 of 3 or 3 of 4, 12 Titans in all. Teammates can't hurt each other and start together; the last team with anyone standing wins. In Cooking Pot Wars each team sets its pot down in the first 30 s (press G) and respawns beside it while it stands. Smash the others' pots with the ladle (G) and carry them home for a stronger pot; if the carrier is splatted, the pot goes back to its spot. While your pot is being carried you watch its carrier: back in if they fall, out if they get it home. Press T at your pot to climb into its turret and fire your food from it.
